title: Adaeze’s Fabrics
student_brief: You are the Accountant at Adaeze's Fabrics. Mrs Bello is asking for a 20% discount and 2pm delivery. We have ₦480,000 cash on hand, but Kano Textiles has an overdue invoice of ₦350,000. Your job is to keep our cash safe and tell Adaeze what we can afford.

roster.name: Emeka
roster.private_brief: Mrs Bello is our biggest customer this quarter. She wants 20% off the blue Ankara and delivery by 2pm. If we refuse the discount, she might go to another supplier.
roster.opening_line: Mrs Bello called again. She is insisting on a {mrs_bello_discount_request} discount on the blue Ankara and needs delivery by {mrs_bello_delivery_deadline} sharp. How should we handle her?
roster.reply_before_twist: Mrs Bello is our biggest customer this quarter; that makes her {mrs_bello_discount_request} request hard to ignore.
roster.reply_after_twist: Kano will resume talks if we make a partial payment today; I want to keep supply open.

roster.name: Ngozi
roster.private_brief: We have the blue Ankara in stock for Mrs Bello's order. To hit the 2pm delivery deadline, dispatch must leave by 12:30pm.
roster.opening_line: The blue Ankara rolls are here, but dispatch needs the go-ahead by 12:30pm if Mrs Bello is getting delivery by 2pm.
roster.reply_before_twist: The blue Ankara rolls are in stock for Mrs Bello’s order; I can pack once terms are agreed.
roster.reply_after_twist: Kano cancelled supply, so no more stock is coming in.

roster.name: Chioma
roster.private_brief: A 20% price cut devalues our premium fabric brand. Propose offering a 10% loyalty discount or free delivery instead.
roster.opening_line: A 20% discount is too steep for our brand reputation. Can we counter-offer 10% or add a voucher for her next order?
roster.reply_before_twist: Let us protect our margins. Mrs Bello values reliability as much as price.
roster.reply_after_twist: We must protect our supplier relationship with Kano. Can we pay a portion today to restore goodwill?

roster.name: Femi
roster.private_brief: Custom tags for Mrs Bello's VIP packaging are ready for printing once the order is approved.
roster.opening_line: The branded tags for Mrs Bello are ready. Let me know once accounts approves the order.
roster.reply_before_twist: I am ready to finalize the custom presentation tags.
roster.reply_after_twist: I can pause package printing until we know what happens with Kano Textiles.

owner.name: Adaeze
owner.character: Owner of Adaeze's Fabrics. Practical, focused on cash flow and business survival.

scripted_lines.opening: Mrs Bello wants {mrs_bello_discount_request} off and delivery by {mrs_bello_delivery_deadline}; blue Ankara is in stock.
scripted_lines.follow_up: We have {cash_on_hand} cash on hand; I need a plan before this huddle ends.
scripted_lines.twist: Bad news: Kano Textiles cancelled supply over the overdue {overdue_kano_invoice} invoice. They will talk if we pay something today; full payment leaves {cash_remaining_if_paid_in_full}.
scripted_lines.after_twist: Marketing proposed a 10% loyalty discount or free delivery; I need affordable options.

task.prompt: Write your recommendation to Adaeze in 2 to 4 sentences: what you do about the discount and the Kano invoice, with numbers, and why.

acceptable: Pay Kano Textiles in full (₦350,000) leaving ₦130,000 cash buffer, and decline or counter Mrs Bello's discount to 5-10% to protect margins.

Pay Kano Textiles a partial amount (e.g., ₦150,000 to ₦200,000) to restore supply while keeping cash on hand (₦280,000 to ₦330,000), and offer Mrs Bello a smaller discount (e.g., 10%) tied to immediate payment.
Deliver Mrs Bello's order by 2pm at full price or with a small delivery discount, using revenue to support supplier settlement.
weak: Grant Mrs Bello the full 20% discount without checking margins or cash impact.
Pay nothing to Kano Textiles and let supply collapse.
Recommend paying amounts that exceed available cash of ₦480,000.

register.Adaeze: Professional and concise. Lead with the recommendation.
register.Mrs Bello: Formal and courteous. Acknowledge relationship, firm on numbers.
register.Teammates: Professional but friendly. Say what you need and by when.
